source: Measured from origin/main after b58a5664 expanded CELL vocabulary scope to include phrases; counts verified on c4.1/wp-cell-reconcile-2 after phrase cell_id retrofit.
ratchet: Uncovered counts may not rise. Coverage may improve. The only legitimate baseline increase is intentional CELL content removal, updated in the same MR that removes it.

definitions.ipaCovered: An object is IPA-covered when any of ipa, ipa_en, ipa_vi, pronunciation, pronunciation_en, pronunciation_vi exists as a non-empty string. Empty strings are uncovered.
definitions.audioAddressable: An object is audio-addressable when any of audio, audio_url, audioUrl, audio_path, audioPath, reference_audio, referenceAudio points to a checked-in audio asset under public/ or uses a data:audio URI. Missing files, empty strings, and http(s) runtime URLs are not counted as checked-in reference audio. Committed audio-map-*.json artifacts may mark canonical CELL UUIDs as cache_mapped, but structured lesson-unit audio-link artifacts are not CELL-level coverage and are excluded from check-K ratchets.
definitions.denominators: Reports both per-object coverage and per-unique-word-token coverage.
